node.statement: PETAL PREDICATE G1 (witness-exhaustive bounded atlas): at every official row and for every received word U, the top-band full-petal contributors are covered by an explicitly defined atlas A_U of fixed (D0,R0) sunflower auxiliary layers. Every chart supplies the injective layer map at agreement a=sigma+d+1-|R0| and coset petals at a printed quotient scale. The TOTAL chart census satisfies |A_U|<=n^b1 for a printed row-independent b1 with b1+b4<=B in the primitive consumer budget. Every contributor lies in at least one chart, enabling first-match assignment. FALSIFIER: an uncovered contributor, a super-polynomial necessary chart census, a failed layer/scale dictionary, or an exponent split that misses B. The former per-codeword chart-multiplicity clause is retired: it did not imply the per-chart K4 sum. [IMPORT REPAIRS 2026-07-12: P1 BAND RESTORED — the atlas quantifies over the floor's band d >= M(t-2) (pin P1, catch #34; maintainer decision still owed). CATCH #79 (against master's 2026-07-10 amber, found by Codex, verified): the old clause (iii) (per-codeword chart overlap <= n^{b1}) plus per-chart K4 did NOT imply the primitive n^{b1+b4} line (counterexample: N disjoint singleton charts); 'machine-verified assembly' covered the budget arithmetic only. The repaired sufficient form is the TOTAL census clause |A_U| <= n^{b1} in the atlas statement above. History: the original G1 statement is preserved in git and the node folder's audit.md.] [CATCH #107 PIN (2026-07-12): atlas charts supply the RETAINED-ZERO constraint — layer maps land in the constrained image G|_{R0} = 0 (true for the banked concrete-layer construction, prop:capf-concrete-sunflower; the G4 dictionary's R0 <-> B0 row carries it) — consumed by K4's Johnson narrowing.] || WEIGHTED-ATLAS RE-POSE (2026-07-13 wave-4 import; the branch rewrote rather than appended — custody-merged per #104/#120; binding new content follows, full text in the node folder): PETAL PREDICATE G1 (quotient-closed witness-exhaustive paid atlas): at every official row and every rate-preserving intrinsic quotient descendant of dyadic length n>=256, for every received word U, the top-band full-petal contributors are covered by a finite first-match atlas A_U of fixed (D0,R0) sunflower auxiliary layers. Every chart supplies the injective map at a=ell+d-|R0|, coset petals at a printed quotient scale, |R0|<ell, d >= ell(m-2), and the retained-zero constraint Psi(P)|_R0=0. The PAID WEIGHTED CENSUS satisfies sum_(chart chi)(m_chi+1)<=(121/128)n^6. K4 bounds chart chi by m_chi+1, so this is the exact aggregate premise consumed downstream. Every contributor has a first covering chart. The retired |A_U|<=n^5 premise implies this weighted form but is not required. FALSIFIER: an uncovered contributor, weighted census above (121/128)n^6, or a failed layer/scale/remainder/band/zero dictionary on an official or consumed quotient row. || FALSIFIER FIRED (2026-07-13, catches #138-#144; packet-grade theorem, engine machine-verified, notes/g1a_*): the WEIGHTED-ATLAS BUDGET CLAUSE (sum <= (121/128) n^6) is FALSIFIED at general parameters — the diamond cofactor equation puts >= C(n'-1,k')/(4q(k'+1)) consumed-band classes at some label vector (exact official instance: n=256, k=128, q=65537: 7.0e29 required vs 2.7e14 budget — 15 orders; s=13 rate-1/2 primary cell over by ~3970 bits; prize-wide for n' >= 256/512). P3-CURSE (#139): uniqueness cuts both ways — no atlas can amortize inside the band (>= 3 weight per class, one class per chart). #140: pinning is EXACTLY j = |S'|-k' in {1,2} (Newton triangular); no deeper pinning exists; the CS/shift-pair route doubly dead. #141: minimal-chart weight is (1-rho)k'+3, not d'+2 (the earlier conflation). #143 HONEST POSITIVE WINDOW (PROVED unconditionally): the DD-consistent-support atlas closes all cells with (k'+2)(C(n'-1,k') + C(n'-1,k'+1)) <= (121/128) n_b^6 — n' <= 32 everywhere, n' = 64 at s >= 12. #144 (THE DEEP ONE): by the S4 bijection the exponential count IS the official scale->=2 top-band census — the n^6-capped demand was the WRONG DEMAND at fiber-rich cells (the mass is ~1/(4q(k'+1)) OF THE PLANTED COLUMN — column-relative it is TINY and consistent with every banked measurement); the re-pose direction is a Q-WEIGHTED SUPPLY-LAW allowance (atlas census priced against the quotient-profile COLUMN for the periodic branch, n^6 only for the primitive branch) or an explicit fiber-starved scope. RE-POSE OWED (next cycle, fresh context): split the atlas budget per branch. || BRANCH-SPLIT RE-POSE r1 (2026-07-13, AUDIT-PENDING — design packet at notes/bsr_repose_20260713/, bsr_check ALL PASS twice; catches #145-#149): G1 splits as G1-prime = (P) + (D).
